name: Sunda Cloak
description: Cloak your DOCX, RTF, and ODT files on-device so AI chatbots find them harder to auto-summarize. Looks the same to you.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; object-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' https://api.lemonsqueezy.com https://huggingface.co https://*.huggingface.co https://*.hf.co; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'none'
